## Noon Product Scraper The Noon Product Scraper is a high-efficiency data extraction tool designed to crawl all the Noon marketplace (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt ...) It retrieves comprehensive product intelligence, including real-time pricing, stock levels, seller metrics, and extensive product specifications. Whether you are monitoring market trends in the Middle East or managing a dropshipping catalog, this scraper provides the structured JSON data necessary for automated decision-making. ## Features Complete SKU Intelligence: Extract unique identifiers including sku, offer_code, and partner_code. Dynamic Pricing & Offers: Capture the price, sale_price, and complex discount structures like "noon One" cashback or seasonal coupon codes (e.g., MOMDAY15). Variant Mapping: Automatically group products by attributes like "Colour Name" or "Size," providing direct links and stock status for every available variant. Seller Performance: Retrieve detailed partner ratings, including "Item as shown" percentage and positive seller feedback. Rich Content Extraction: Scrape high-resolution image_urls, detailed feature_bullets, and full long_description (HTML supported). Logistics & Fulfillment: Access estimated delivery dates, shipping fees, return policies, and "Buy Now, Pay Later" (BNPL) installment breakdowns. Technical Specifications: Extract structured data for dimensions, materials, and category-specific attributes. ## Use Cases Dynamic Price Monitoring: Track price fluctuations on Noon to stay competitive in the MENA retail landscape. Logistics Analysis: Compare delivery speeds and "Fulfilled by Noon" (FBN) status across different product categories. Competitor Benchmarking: Analyze seller ratings and metrics to understand how top-performing partners manage their stores. Catalog Syncing: Populate your own e-commerce platform with accurate, localized product descriptions and high-quality imagery from Noon's CDN.
